notes: v677 - the bot no longer writes the day off while its report is re-grading. When you change the liquidity floor (or open a fresh profile), the bot rightly refuses a card graded at a different floor - but until now that stand-aside consumed its one automatic run for the day, even though the re-grade at your current floor lands seconds later. Now such a run keeps the day open and quietly tries again once the fresh card arrives (bounded, so a server that cannot answer still ends the day cleanly). The diary says so in plain words. Change your floor to anything, and the bot adjusts and carries on - the same run-again courtesy a human would give themselves. Practice money only. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
